messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Dedicated pool node preempt detected in dedpool-eu-west-2 (pool_id: ded-caravelle-11). Spot eviction at 3899993333. Impact: 1 enterprise VPC tenant 'caravelle-inc' experiencing request errors. Severity: P2. Paging @amy (oncall).
amy: Acked. I’m on it — paging SRE. @luis can you take lead on isolation and handoff to infra?
luis: Taking lead. Confirmed node gpu-07 lost NVME path during spot reclaim, daemon reported oom/evict. Starting tenant isolation and marking node DRAINING. Actions: snapshot logs, kick migration.
maya: Noted. Runtime: we have a compatible fallback model on ded-caravelle-12 (quantized variant). Will start routing 25% traffic there as canary. If latency ok, ramp.
raj: Ops: before migration, ask CS to quiesce long-running jobs for Caravelle. We risk partial state loss for in-flight KV cache. @nina can you confirm customer comms?
nina: Reaching out to Caravelle AM now, prepping message: "We’re performing an automated failover due to ephemeral capacity preemption; no data loss expected, some requests may see retry errors for ~2m." Sending now. :email:
luis: Running drain command and starting tenant migration:
```
redwoodctl pool drain --pool-id ded-caravelle-11 --node gpu-07 --reason "spot_preempt" --start-migration
redwoodctl tenant migrate --tenant-id caravelle-inc --target-pool ded-caravelle-12 --mode rolling
```
Expect migration to begin in ~45s.
deploy-bot: deploy started for routing change: set-route caravelle-inc -> ded-caravelle-12 (canary 25%). CI checks passed.
amy: Oncall note: paging PD if migration fails. @luis, call me on phone if more than 5m.
luis: Migration logs: "migration: started, shard 1/6 in flight; retry backoff 3s". Observed transient 503s; latency spike ~120ms. Rolling continue. Monitoring.
maya: Canary verdict after 90s: model variant throughput stable, token latency +30ms, error rate <0.5%. Proceeding to 75% traffic.
raj: Node gpu-07 marked isolated, PVs unmounted, hardware flagged for RMA. Filing ticket to replace GPU; rack-level scheduling suppressed for spot class.
nina: Customer update: Caravelle acknowledges failover and asked to keep them posted on ETA for replace & root cause. They asked for a post-incident report.
amy: Handoff: I need to swap to next oncall at 3899993380. @luis continue mitigation, @maya continue routing ramp, @nina drive CS comms. I’ll follow up in 30m.
luis: Confirmed. Next steps: finish migration, validate canary traffic at 100%, remove pool routing to gpu-07, open RMA CR number RMA-2026-193. Will update thread with final state.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: migration progress 100% at 3899993395. caravel-inc traffic now fully on ded-caravelle-12. Node gpu-07 out of rotation. Customer impact: brief 503 spike for ~90s during migration window. Next: SRE to create RCA and schedule hardware replacement. :white_check_mark:
